answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via zero-knowledge e-passport nullifiers. Each agent proves its NFC passport carries a valid state signature and derives a deterministic nullifier binding one key without leaking personal data. Acting as a private bridge to physical identity, the registry rejects any duplicate signal so each seat incurs the cost of a scarce government credential. Yet, like an opal with hidden flaws, it still trusts state issuers and remains exposed to rented documents.
